hero.heading: The unconference Bangalore builds together.
hero.sub: No fixed agenda. No keynote speakers. Just a room full of curious people and a blank schedule — filled in by whoever shows up with something to say.

what.label: 01 — What's an unconference
what.heading: You decide what to talk about. You're in control.
what.body: There's no speaker list until the day itself. The schedule is built live — by you, and everyone else who walks in with a topic, a story, or a half-formed idea worth arguing about.
what.photo_caption:
PHOTO
attendees pitching a session on the board

who.label: 02 — Who shows up
who.heading: The most outside-the-box thinkers in the city. No, really.
who.body: Design, tech, creativity, entrepreneurship, astronomy, music — if it crosses boundaries, steps on toes, or just spreads joy, we want to hear about it.

moments.label: Moments from BCB
moments.heading: A few frames from years past.

cards.title: Talks
cards.text: Six rooms, six sessions running at once. Don't like one? Get up and walk into another — we call that the law of two feet.

cards.title: Techlash
cards.text: Your six minutes of fame. Show the crowd something you built and inspire the room.

board.label: How the day takes shape
board.heading: The board fills in as the day goes.
board.body: No printed agenda — just a whiteboard, a pack of sticky notes, and whoever grabs a marker first.
board.collapsed_text: ROOMS 01 · 02 · 03 — six sessions, a stack of posties, and a marker.
board.hint: ↑ this is what the board looked like at the last BCB. bring your own posties.
board._help: items[].type: 'slot' = a time row (cells: null = empty, string = sticky note, {"plain": "text"} = handwritten text). 'break' = full-width row, style is one of big | break | techlash | feedback.

cards.title: Introductory
cards.text: Introduce an idea, a tool, a lifestyle. Bridge the gap — start your cult.

cards.title: Open discussion
cards.text: Need feedback or opinions from the room? This format gets everyone talking.

cards.title: Deep dive
cards.text: Take an idea and dig in. Best suited for intermediate/expert-level talks.

rsvp_section.heading: Let us know you're coming.
rsvp_section.body: Your RSVP helps us plan an accurate headcount so the day runs smoothly for everyone.
